content.thinking: Round 2 plan: resubmit with simpler geometry. The last rejection was volume mismatch ~0.8%, maybe boolean tolerance artifact. Simplify: use ellipsoids with mild rotations, fewer features, maybe two puffs only. Keep sizes valid.
